narrative.overview: BytesAI Learning is a curated discovery platform, and its interface should feel like a trusted editor has already done the sorting. The visual system is built around restraint, hierarchy, and clarity: generous whitespace, a single disciplined accent, and typography that does the communicating. Every surface reinforces that the product is making choices on the user's behalf — not aggregating everything and asking them to filter. The design rejects the generic SaaS dark-mode clone, the cold blue/purple space aesthetic, the hero-metric landing page, and the marketplace chaos of catalogues.
keyCharacteristics: Light default, dark by choice. Both themes use cool tinted neutrals with a single violet accent.
One type family, Inter, used across display, body, and labels. Hierarchy comes from weight and scale.
Cards and containers sit on slightly lifted surfaces with soft shadows; depth is structural.
Touch targets are generous; motion is short, ease-out, and reserved for state feedback.
The accent color is used sparingly for primary actions, current navigation, and verified states.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Editorial Violet is the only accent on 90% of any screen. Secondary semantic colors are reserved for specific states.

rules.name: The Light-First Rule
rules.body: The default experience is light. Dark mode is a first-class variant, not the primary identity.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Inter handles every text role. Do not introduce a second font for display or decorative headings.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Body paragraphs in long-form contexts must not exceed 75ch. Wide running text is forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus).

dos: Do cap body paragraphs at 65–75ch in any reading context.
Do use Editorial Violet as the only accent on most screens.
Do use the fully rounded pill shape for primary and outline buttons.
Do ensure every interactive element has a visible focus-visible state.
Do use reduced-motion fallbacks for any animation.
Do use semantic colors only for their named purpose.
donts: Don't use gradient text or background-clip text for headings.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface treatment.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px as a colored accent.
Don't use identical card grids as the default layout pattern.
Don't decorate with gradients, glows, or animations that do not carry meaning.
Don't use display fonts or decorative typefaces for UI labels, buttons, or data.
Don't build dark mode with cold blue/purple space aesthetics or neon accents.
Don't create marketplace-style visual chaos; the curation should feel edited, not aggregated.
Don't use tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section heading.
